content.text:
As of November 18, 2026, the current flagships are the **iPhone 18 Pro Max** and the **Pixel 11 Pro XL**. The iPhone is the better camera overall. The Pixel is cheaper and wins on zoom.

## Price in CAD (before tax, unlocked)

| Storage | iPhone 18 Pro Max | Pixel 11 Pro XL |
|---|---|---|
| 256GB | $1,899 | $1,799 |
| 512GB | $2,199 | $1,969 |
| 1TB | $2,799 | $2,269 |

- The iPhone prices come from [iPhone in Canada](https://www.iphoneincanada.ca/2026/09/09/iphone-18-pro-canadian-pricing-starts-at-1749-available-september-18). The site says they're $150 more than last year's iPhone 17 Pro Max.
- The Pixel prices come from [PC Guide](https://www.pcguide.com/news/google-pixel-11-pro-xl-fold-pre-order-where-to-buy) and [PriceSlash](https://priceslashstore.com/blog/google-pixel-11-pro-fold-watch-5-canadian-pricing). The Google Store page I opened didn't show a price, so I couldn't confirm these against Google directly. PriceSlash says the Pro XL is up $170 CAD from last year.
- The Pixel is $100 cheaper at 256GB and $330 cheaper at 512GB. The iPhone also offers a 2TB model at $3,699.

## Camera

**Hardware**
- **iPhone 18 Pro Max:** Three 48MP rear cameras. The main camera has a new variable aperture (f/1.48 to f/4.0). The telephoto is 4x optical zoom. The selfie camera is 18MP ([Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/ive-spent-months-testing-the-iphone-18-pro-max-galaxy-s26-ultra-and-pixel-11-pro-xl-heres-the-flagship-i-recommend)).
- **Pixel 11 Pro XL:** A 50MP main camera, a 48MP ultrawide and a 48MP 5x telephoto. Google enlarged the telephoto sensor this year. The selfie camera is 42MP.

**Where the iPhone is better** ([BGR](https://www.bgr.com/2304081/iphone-18-pro-max-vs-pixel-11-pro-xl-which-camera-best))
- BGR judges the iPhone's overall camera and portraits better, with more natural colour and better low-light shots from the variable aperture.
- Its video is stronger. [Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/ive-used-the-pixel-11-pro-xl-and-iphone-18-pro-max-3720239) agrees that the Pixel still lags on video.
- It behaves the same way every time, whereas the Pixel shipped with a camera app bug that sometimes left the viewfinder out of focus.

**Where the Pixel is better**
- Zoom reaches up to 120x. BGR says it becomes unreliable past about 80x because it starts inventing detail. The iPhone has no AI boost and stops being reliable past about 20x.
- Night Sight is faster and more consistent under mixed lighting.
- Its main camera has excellent detail, but BGR found colours slightly muted.

**Lab-style test:** One lab-style YouTube comparison, [iPhone 18 Pro vs. Pixel 11 Pro](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4CB20EWtQ3Q), called it close. It gave the iPhone a slight edge on photos and more resolved detail. It gave the Pixel a slight edge on video colour accuracy and stabilization. That is the one result that disagrees with other reviews on video, so I'd weigh it less.

## Bottom line
- **Choose the iPhone 18 Pro Max** if you shoot a lot of video or want the most reliable everyday camera. It costs $100 to $530 more, depending on storage.
- **Choose the Pixel 11 Pro XL** if you want long zoom and faster night shots, or want to save money, especially at 512GB and above.

I compared the Pro Max and Pro XL models. The smaller iPhone 18 Pro ($1,749) and Pixel 11 Pro ($1,499) have the same cameras and cost less.
